name: POST /api/pilot-requests - request a pilot from the website
description: Public website form. Stores a pilot request (name, work email, firm, optional role, message) for operators to follow up, and returns ONLY the new id, so no visitor data is ever echoed or shown to anyone else. The client IP is never stored: an HMAC of it is kept for the per-IP limit (PILOT_REQUESTS_PER_IP_PER_HOUR, default 5). Edge cases: work email is lower-cased; message needs 10+ characters; a filled honeypot field (website) is refused with REQUEST_REJECTED; over the hourly limit answers 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After: 3600. Covers: a visitor can submit a pilot request and invalid or abusive requests are rejected.

errorCases.when: name, workEmail, firmName or message missing

errorCases.message: workEmail must be a valid email address
message must be at least 10 characters

errorCases.notReproducibleReason: Test suites submit from one IP and run many times an hour, so test environments raise the limit; asserting the 429 would lock the happy path out. Verified by hand with PILOT_REQUESTS_PER_IP_PER_HOUR=3 (4th request: 429, Retry-After: 3600).
